title: Optimal fractional discrete Hardy inequalities on the half-line
summary: We consider a Toeplitz realisation of the fractional discrete Laplacian $(-Δ)^α$ on the half-line $\mathbb{N}$ as a compression of the full-line fractional discrete Laplacian to $\ell^{2}(\mathbb{N})$. For all $α>0$, we prove that the fractional Hardy inequality $$(-Δ)^α\geq\frac{4^αΓ^2(α+1/2)}π\frac{Γ(2\,\cdot\,-1)}{Γ(2\,\cdot\,-1+2α)}$$ holds on $\ell^{2}(\mathbb{N})$ and is optimal in a strong sense.
